rows.text: Ah, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], I knew you wouldn't miss such a splendid occasion. If you need any help during the banquet, don't hesitate to let me know!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Dux Helkolithist, let's have a chat.
Since you're in the mood for conversation, I certainly wouldn't want to spoil it. What do you want to talk about?
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Let's talk about your past.
You're curious about my past? Hah, I fear you'll be disappointed — there are no tales of intrigue to share
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: In my youth, I joined the Grove, immersed in studies beneath its all-shrouding sky dome.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Rising from student to mentor, then professor, and finally sage... it all unfolded as if destined.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Only when the Imperator raised the Flame-Chase banner did I see beyond the sky dome to a sky swallowed by calamity.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Yet under the Titans' protection, most Sages of the Grove remained willfully blind, shackled by self-indulgent "knowledge"...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: When persuasion failed, I left the Grove. As Imperator's advisor, I marshaled armies to shoulder this world's burdens.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Let's talk about your future.
The future? I'll do my duty, awaiting Amphoreus's rebirth. Nothing more.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: The sea of stars fascinated the Imperator, but holds no allure for me. My sole concern is Amphoreus's fate.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Perhaps when they sail triumphantly toward the cosmos... I'll return to the Grove, a common sage lost in books... and occasional exercise.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Done chatting for now.
Alright. I won't bother you anymore, great one. Another time!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: You haven't had anything on your mind lately, have you?
Something on my mind? If I had to say something... Getting heckled by everyone when I'm walking beside Verginia is kind of an annoyance.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: I don't really care, but Verginia's shy. She can't help but hide behind me when this happens.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: However... and maybe it's an old problem from me being a sage and an advisor... I keep thinking a thought about... well, what if the Flame-Chase Journey truly can be as perfect as imagined?
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Bro, don't be like that...
Destroy it, it's gonna reset...
Hah, why the tension, dear guest? As a sage of the Flame-Chase, such worries are only natural.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: However, there is something that truly troubles the heart that I wish to share with you. Ever since Verginia confessed to me, I feel that the attention I give her is gradually overwhelming everything else...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: To be honest, this makes me a bit fearful. For the advisor of the Flame-Chase Army, this is not a good sign.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: When we sail again, I'll strive to focus. But until then, let us savor this splendid banquet...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Maybe it will be okay if I slightly indulge myself a little...
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Another time!
Alright. I won't bother you anymore, great one. Another time!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius
